scope: research-only continuation of syscoin/PVUGC PR #1; no production files changed
construction_attempt: padded high-order proper-moment exclusion block intended to amplify a unique local rejection from one-hot weight 1 to weight 2^R-1
proved_claims: Over F_2, the ideal proper-moment exclusion block has a unique one-hot solution for every accepted target and the unique all-ones solution of weight 2^R-1 for the rejected target.

If those nonlinear query features were trusted and bound to one Boolean proof, the binary additive capsule has TV(P0,P1) <= rho*sqrt(S) with S <= 2^W rho^(2(B+M-1)) on false statements, giving polynomial M=Theta(B(W+kappa)) for fixed honest raw success.

For every affine local syndrome map sigma(q), a uniquely rejected Boolean query q* is the affine combination of three accepted neighboring queries; corresponding accepted linear preimages combine to an exact rejected preimage with norm at most their norm sum and support at most their support sum.

If only degree-0/1 query features are tied to the real query while higher proper-monomial features are free linear auxiliaries, an explicit three-row representation matches the real raw query but forges the higher features and bypasses the ideal high-order gap.
The graph of Boolean multiplication is non-affine, so no exact projection of a purely linear F_2 system with auxiliaries can enforce that nonlinear feature graph.
not_claimed: No standard-LWE/SIS reduction for the missing nonlinear feature binder.
No arbitrary-QPT early-key-recovery to source-witness extraction theorem.
No claim that tests establish cryptographic security.
No claim that the ideal trusted-feature BSC parameter cases are deployable or practical.
No claim that every nonlinear or computational binder is impossible.
remaining_gap: Construct a public offline PQ nonlinear feature/common-witness binder whose complete public transcript does not expose a no-witness equivalent, then prove arbitrary-QPT early key recovery yields a source witness or an independently justified PQ break and compose malicious-secure erased setup with concrete parameters.
